key_insight: SolCloudLLM combines sky images and historical time-series in a bidirectional multimodal LLM framework to better forecast PV power and GHI, especially when clouds drive rapid changes.
engineering_relevance: Improved short-term solar forecasting can directly support dispatch, reserve planning, and grid operations by reducing ramp-related forecast errors.
method: Aligns sky-image patches with time-series patches.
Fuses the two modalities through bidirectional multimodal fusion.
Maps the unified representation into an LLM embedding space for forecasting.
evidence_signal: On the SIRTA and SKIPP'D datasets, the method outperformed the best baselines across all horizons, with up to 25.4% relative MSE reduction and strong few-shot performance.
watch_item: The approach depends on site-specific sky imagery and local observing conditions, so deployment may require careful data collection, synchronization, and camera robustness checks.
paper_title: Bidirectional Multimodal Fusion of Sky Images and Time-Series for Solar Forecasting with Large Language Models
